messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to the version where the person has red hair and apply the following edit to that version: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, turns from a side profile to face away from the camera, and raises one arm to touch the back of her head while the other hand rests on her hip.","camera":"A low-angle full-body shot that slowly orbits around the character from her left side to her back.","clothing":"A short dress with a black-and-white patterned bodice, black off-the-shoulder sleeves, and a black skirt with a white diagonal panel, paired with light blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Bright red.","hairstyle":"Short hair tied into a low bun at the nape of the neck.","identity":"A slender 3D-rendered female character with fair skin, shown in profile and then from behind.","scene":"A sunlit European-style city street with brick buildings, a Union Jack flag, street lamps, and a cobblestone road."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a modern rooftop with cranes and industrial structures to a sunlit European-style street with brick buildings, a Union Jack flag, street lamps, and cobblestones. The character's red hair, dress, pose, turning motion, and low-angle orbiting camera remain largely consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original rooftop/industrial scene with the European cobblestone street environment from the reference, while preserving the red-haired character's identity, appearance, action, camera framing, and movement.
unexpected_changes: Lighting on the character changed from warm sunset tones to brighter daylight, consistent with the new environment.
